title: All Pale Garden Challenge
description: This datapack makes it so that you will go through a challenge in the new pale garden biome.
body:
# About **All Pale Garden Challenge**
**All Pale Garden Challenge** is a datapack that adds a new dimension where there only is Pale Garden. Fight off creakings and other mobs.
## Features
- Custom structures
- A new boss (The Creaker)
- New armor
### Good to know
- Remember to start the world with commands enabled.
- To start type **/reload** in the chat
- When you start the challenge you will spawn with 1hp
